executiveSummary: Multiple high-risk advisories and active campaigns elevate near-term risk for OT environments, including targeted activity against Siemens S7 PLCs, critical unauthenticated RCE paths in Siemens industrial software (via vulnerable Brotli/Node.js), and actively exploited edge/VPN gateways. Rapid, coordinated action is required across identity, perimeter, and engineering workstation/SCADA stacks. Active targeting of Siemens S7 PLCs with AI-assisted scripts and snap7 tooling raises immediate risk of unauthorized memory reads/writes and potential process disruption; remove internet exposure, enforce segmentation, and monitor S7comm on TCP/102. Security Advisory Critical RCE ("Node2Shell"/Brotli C decoder) impacts numerous Siemens industrial software suites (WinCC/UMC/TIA/Opcenter/Teamcenter, etc.). Disable Brotli at gateways, patch Node.js/Brotli components, and apply Siemens mitigations. ICS Advisory 1 ICS Advisory 2 Siemens SIMATIC WinCC/PCS 7/Process Historian exposed to NTLM relay-based auth bypass; enforce SQL/TLS encryption, reduce NTLM, prefer Kerberos SPNs, and segment ICS networks. ICS Advisory CISA flags critical Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) in JDK Base64 decoder; inventory bundled JREs in OT/DMZ, patch urgently, and implement input controls where patching is delayed. CISA Alert Edge/VPN exploitation is ongoing: Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway unauth RCE is observed in the wild; treat previously unpatched devices as potentially compromised. CERT-FR Alert Active APT and ransomware operations (e.g., Void Blizzard via Zimbra zero-day; SafePay/Gunra) continue to drive IT compromises with credible IT-to-OT pivot potential. Zimbra Advisory SafePay Advisory Gunra Advisory Multiple OT gateways/devices (Advantech EKI-1242, Danfoss iC7) and EV charging/OCPP paths show unauth RCE/management abuse vectors-immediately isolate from untrusted networks and apply vendor guidance. CISA Weekly CISA Weekly China-nexus covert networks leveraging compromised SOHO/IoT devices and router misconfigurations enable stealthy targeting of CNI; enforce router hygiene and treat residential-origin traffic as potentially hostile. Covert Networks Advisory Router Hygiene Advisory

items: Siemens SIMATIC/WinCC/UMC/TIA: NTLM relay auth-bypass and Brotli/Node.js RCE across many products-apply Siemens mitigations, disable Brotli, enforce Kerberos TLS for SQL. NTLM Relay Brotli (Set 1) Brotli (Set 2)
Advantech EKI-1242EIMS/IEIMS: Unauth root command exec, missing auth, unsigned firmware acceptance; restrict TCP/5058, enforce auth, patch when available. CISA Weekly
Danfoss iC7 drives: exposed debug/update interfaces and unsigned load paths-air-gap service/debug ports and require code signing. CISA Weekly
Citrix NetScaler ADC/Gateway: multiple unauth RCEs actively exploited; reimage and rotate secrets after patching; restrict exposure. CERT-FR Alert
SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN (KEV): single-factor exposure actively exploited; patch, enforce MFA, and verify for pre-patch compromise. CISA KEV
Dorsett Controls InfoScan (water SCADA/HMI): info disclosure via unauth requests-upgrade and remove internet exposure. ICS Advisory

descriptions: Initial Access: Exploit Public-Facing Application (Enterprise T1190; ICS T0819); Valid Accounts (T1078); External Remote Services (T1133).
Execution/Lateral Movement: Remote Services (T1021: RDP/SMB/WinRM); Abuse of vSphere APIs/SSH for ESXi; PLC protocol access (S7comm on TCP/102).
Credential Access: OS credential dumping, NTLM relay, LSASS protections bypass attempts; OAuth/app password abuse in Zimbra.
Defense Evasion: Living-off-the-land (PsExec/WMIC/PowerShell); cloud API abuse (Graph/GitHub/Ably in Operation ShadowCloud).
Exfiltration/Impact: Cloud storage (Mega/Rclone), email mass export, VM shutdown/encryption, controller parameter manipulation.

outlook72h: - Expect opportunistic exploitation spikes on Java4Shell and Brotli/Node.js after media amplification; prioritize internet-facing services and Siemens stacks for emergency windows. - Continued probing of NetScaler/SonicWall; monitor for post-exploitation lateral movement on jump hosts and identity systems. - Elevated risk of S7 access attempts; increase S7comm telemetry, alert on unauthorized PUT/GET and off-hours sessions. - Ransomware operators likely to target virtualization/backup planes; validate restoration readiness and tighten access.
